main_text.p: struitur cum Accusat.rei & persona,& Præposit. ל. Præ-teric. וְחַנּוֹתִי אֶת־אֲשֶׁר אָחֹן Gratiosus ero cui fuero gra-tiosus, Exod.33.19. Infinit. הַשְׂכֵּחַ חַנּוֹת An oblitus est gratiam facere, Psalm.77.10. cui similem formam vide in שָׁמַם. Futur. irregulare, יְחָנֶּךָּ חָנוֹן Gratiam faciendo gratiam faciet tibi, Iesa.30.19. & sic Genes.43.29. Nun autem debebat esse dageffatum, ut dicitur וַיְחָנֶּךָּ Et gratiam faciat tibi, Num.6.25. Chald. Infinit. בְּמַחֵן עָנִין Gratiam faciendo pauperibus afflictis, Daniel.4. v.24. Niph. Præter. anomalum, מַה־נֶּחְנַתִּי Quàm gratiosa tibi eris, quàm gratulaberis tibi, Jer.22.23. deficit Dagesch, ut ante in Futuro Kal. Pih. Part. מְחוֹנֵן Gratiam faciens, Prov.14.12. Infin. עֵת לְחָנְנָה Tempus est gratiam faciendi ei, Psal.102.14. ubi Segol est loco Pathach, & ex ּ abest Dagesch, pro לְחָנָּנָה. Hoph.Fut. יְחֻנַּן Grata fiet, Iesa.26. v.10. Hithp. הִתְחַנֵּן Precari, Deprecari; proprie pro gratia, vel ut gratia fiat: Infin. לְהִתְחַנֵּן־לוֹ Ad deprecandum eum, Esth.4.8. Chald.Partic. וּמִתְחַנֵּן Et deprecantem, Dan.6.11.

חֵן m. Gratia: חֵן מָצָא Invenit gratiam, Gen.6.8. Et in Chirek, וְחֵין עָרְכּוֹ Et gratiam dispositionis ejus, Job.41.3. Aff. וַיִּתֵּן חֵנוֹ Et dedit gratiam ejus, id est, לוֹ ipsi, Gen.39. v.21. id est, Conciliavit ipsi gratiam.
חִנָּם Gratis, Immeritò, Frustrà, Absque caussa: וַעֲבַדְתַּנִי חִנָּם Et servies mihi gratis, Genes.29. v.15. Sic Exod.21.11. לְהָמִית אֶת דָּוִד חִנָּם Occidendo Davidem sine caussa, 1.Sam.19.5.
תְּחִנָּה f, Precatio, Deprecatio, Supplicatio, 1.Reg.8. v.54. Constr. אֶל־תְּחִנַּת עַבְדְּךָ Ad deprecationem servi tui, Ibid. vers.30. Aff. וְאֶל־תְּחִנָּתוֹ Et ad precationem ejus,

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek vocalisation is hard to read at this scan resolution; vowel points and dagesh marks in the Hebrew forms may be inexact. The entry חנינה and the vowel-pointed forms in the Infinitive and Hithpael entries are the least certain. No [?] markers were added because the reading of the Hebrew letters is generally clear, but the points should be checked against the original. The reversed-type symbol after "ex" and the preposition ל in "Præposit. ל" are as printed. Line-end hyphens in "Præ-teric" and "gra-tiosus" are printed hyphens and are kept.
